summary: The prepared source reproduced the DFLASH/DSPARK draft KV budget defect: the resolver passed global tp_size to draft_model_config.get_num_kv_heads even though draft KV allocation is sharded by attn_tp_size. The fix changes that resolver argument to attn_tp_size. A resolver-level regression failed before the change for full and partial DP-attention layouts, passed after it, and also covers the unchanged no-DP boundary.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before regression: full DP attention observed topology width 16 instead of 1; partial DP attention observed 16 instead of 4; the no-DP width-16 boundary passed. Raw output: reports/j-1e99e9e5a4ef/evidence/failing-before.txt
Passing-after resolver regression across attn_tp_size 1, 4, and 16. Raw output: reports/j-1e99e9e5a4ef/evidence/passing-after-resolver.txt
Existing DFLASH combined target/draft budget tests, including DCP replication and HybridSWA capacity. Raw output: reports/j-1e99e9e5a4ef/evidence/passing-existing-dflash.txt

On AMD Instinct MI350X gfx950, actual bfloat16 GPU tensors for the regression geometry occupied 40960, 10240, and 2560 bytes at attn_tp_size 1, 4, and 16 respectively, confirming the 16x endpoint storage ratio. Raw output: reports/j-1e99e9e5a4ef/evidence/gfx950-kv-byte-check.txt

gpu_execution.evidence: A single assigned AMD Instinct MI350X (gfx950) executed the independent draft-KV allocation-byte check. This was not a full Kimi-K3, DSPARK serving, 16-GPU, or multi-node reproduction.

remaining_limitations: The reported Kimi-K3/DSPARK deployment requires model weights and a 16-way DP-attention topology; neither was available, so the original full-model OOM was not reproduced.
The assigned environment had one gfx950 GPU, while the report used B300 GPUs. GPU validation was limited to allocation sizes for the same draft KV geometry.
No native code changed, so no native rebuild was applicable.
Production source path: python/sglang/srt/model_executor/model_runner_components/spec_aux_hidden_state.py; regression source path: test/registered/unit/model_executor/test_spec_aux_hidden_state.py.
